note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/e0274901/cash-bids?units=us — the site id e0274901 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://www.countryvisionscoop.com/grain/cash-bids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (17737) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is absent because no single rule explained every testable row on this board. The identity guard stays exact. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 4 row(s) for this location. STATE AND ADDRESS READ, NOT INFERRED. Premier, Allied, Country Partners, Country Visions and Ag-Land FS each publish their own locations list; the state and street below were read off it on 2026-08-25 and not inferred from the operator's headquarters. TOLERANCE SET FROM THIS BOARD'S OWN MEASURED RESIDUAL, 0.5c. The first live run refused it on cash - basis = futures. Every residual across 74 rows was a QUARTER-CENT MULTIPLE and never exceeded 0.5c: -0.25c x30, +0.25c x22, +0.5c x22. Mixed signs mean BOTH the displayed cash and the displayed basis are rounded to the whole cent independently, so no rounding rule applied to one of them can ever reconcile the pair -- floor, round and ceiling were each tried against every row and none explained the board. Corn futures trade in quarter cents; this is arithmetic, not error. The number is this operator's OWN maximum, not a blanket: three of the four boards settled here need 0.5c, which is the two-tick torn-read threshold and therefore widens nothing at all. Re-measure it if their display ever changes. COORDINATE filled 44.26985,-87.64442 from geocodes/places.json on 2026-08-29, keyed on this source's own id and resolved from "14215 CO RD B, MISHICOT, WI, 54228" via census. It is a STREET-level fix on the elevator itself. EVIDENCE, NOT A FACT: check it against the operator's own published address before anything depends on the distance.
